_readme: Source directory for the public Wire page.
A source appears on the site ONLY if it has a url AND verified is true.
There is no unlinked state - an entry the reader cannot click is not worth
the line it sits on. Empty groups drop out with their heading, and the page
leaves the navigation entirely if nothing verifies.
To add a source: find the real URL, paste it in with verified false, then run
scripts/check-wire.mjs. It sets verified only on a live 200. Adding a URL
without running the check changes nothing on the site, deliberately.
Only 404 and 410 mean dead. A 403 is a bot wall and a 5xx is a bad day.
